text: I'm not the biggest fan of folders being on a second page, separated from the first page which only shows camera roll photos. And for some reason, I can't delete photos anymore? It just pulls up an infinitely-looping circle of doom and does nothing. Strange stuff. Otherwise, the app has amazing features that I really enjoy. I love that I can order photos through the app. While I haven't used it yet, I certainly plan to! Altogether, I really just use the app became it came pre-installed.

Within the last 48 hours, I've probably uninstalled and reinstalled this apt close to 10 times. When the app finally backs-up photos, it's missing some (photos that are in my albums on my phone aren't showing up in app). Also when I click on a photo in the app, it opens a different picture. I'm thinking to uninstall app entirely. You'd think Google, of all software out there, could get this right!

I HATE the new organization of Collections. Now I have to click through multiple menus to find my folders, it takes longer and I don't want or need it. I also wish I could default to open on my Device folders which is what I use the most. I do not care about Memories. I hate the pop-ups that constantly ask me to back up my photos (which I do not want to do). This app gets worse and worse with every update. At least allow us to customize our default view! Please!!

Your last update is terrible. You removed the blur option which was AMAZING for blurring the background of my photos of flowers. The flowers would just pop with a heavy blur. The portrait blur is not nearly as good, especially when I use blur and depth to get my flowers to look how I want them to. It DOES look good, but when I save it, the blur almost disappears. Your "upgrade" is really a downgrade.

ugh! what have you done to the editing controls!! get rid of the inefficient and inaccurate AI garage and bring back the custom controls that let me rotate and keystone and crop! AI framing isn't even close to correct! and the manual controls are now so limited I can't even select the correct borders or rotate correctly. the old controls were so much better! one click would pretty closely grab the correct outline and then I could tweak. not anymore!!!

This app is practically unusable anymore. The search engine doesn't ever freaking work when trying to find a specific photo, Even on Wi-Fi the page loads slow when trying to find a picture(Or doesn't load at all), It still doesn't have an option to where it can just save all of your photos/videos into albums without having to manually create them again. I'm only giving this 2 stars because it's one of the only ways that I know to backup my device photos without having to use a PC.

Service has steadily declined for years now. Lots of features just completely don't work, for example saving a new frame from a motion photo. They removed the ability to search your photos if they aren't backed up. The cherry on top is recently they added an effect to your memories so that a large number comes in and shows you how many years it's been, unfortunately this new effect has ruined to quality of every single photo it shows. I really don't know how some of this leaves beta.

the new update makes zero sense, I likes it where I was able to just watch all my albums in one go, instead now it's all folder inside of folder?! I have bad memory and can't always remember if I've backed up a photo already, or if it's still on my device, not to mention now there's a pets and people tab, which you'd think would be nice, but no! I get constant reminders of people I don't want to see anymore with photos I thought were gone! thanks a lot Google, and not in a nice way!

Since the update, I can't choose separate photos for my lock screen wallpaper or main wallpaper. There is only an option for "wallpaper" now, which stretches and distorts the photo to fit the size of the screen! Also in order to continue editing a photo, I have to revert back to the original and edit all over again! Please go back to the original options; why do companies feel the need to constantly change everything every couple months, and not to their users' preference?? So frustrating!

i really don't like this app. i don't like the 'moments' it randomly creates that can't be turned off. i don't like that albums aren't on the same level as the default categories (for example if you take a photo from the downloads category and put it in an album it still exists in the downloads category.) i don't like the facial detection grouping, it rarely works and just adds to the already messy layout. i could say more but i'm running out of characters.

this app used to be perfect, but the quality has gone downhill. the new ai search rarely finds the photos i want in comparison to the old search where i'd find my photos every time. there's also a recent bug where adding photos to an album sometimes creates duplicates, and they are really hard to get rid of. it seems to be related to a delay when pressing the button to add a collection of photos, sometimes this hangs for like 10 seconds and i think if i press it twice i get duplicates.

This is a terrible app. Yet another example of Google hiding basic functionality and usability from their users, whom Google clearly doesn't care for. Prime example: a photo's details used to be easily available, from a simple menu selection, but aren't any more. And no, the swipe up doesn't bring the details up. Just looking to use my phone, Google!

The widget has no album option. it kind of feels like a major oversight because it seems like the most obvious option, but for some reason you're not really given any control of the photos that go up other than faces and moments. Both of those you don't really have the most control over and are curated for you. It's also strange because they don't even have the second obvious one, Favorites.

Photos used to be the perfect photos app. it had the best search funding of any app. I used to race iphone users to see how far we could find the same photo and I always won. Now this near perfect search function has been replaced by AI, which not only doesn't return the photos I'm looking for, it actually acts as a stumbling block to me finding them. It's slow and inefficient. Another perfectly good tool ruined in the name of trying to convince us that AI is inevitable.

Not intuitive for digital art, which most of my pictures are. The Memories and Face Recognition and such only pay attention to the (very few) actual photos and thus are not helpful. AI tools are trash. If this app wasn't conveniently synced to my Google account I would uninstall and find something else. Also, make the "folders" button easier to get to, and then STOP MOVING IT AROUND! And stop rearranging the order of the *comic panels* in my *album*.

why would you take away the ability to share multiple photos at once? I had to send 10 separate emails, with one photo attached a piece, because you took the ability to share multiple photos away! Such a stupid change. In response to Google. No you can not. when you click on a single photo now, you get a share button, if you select multiple photos, the share button is no longer there after the update

Even with the latest updates, it would not let you edit or add location to the backup photos. Some of the photos detected the wrong person or pet or face, and again, it would not let you edit with correct categories. There are many little things like that they need to be more detail oriented when they come out with new/update version.

this app worked great until recently. now anytime I crop or edit a picture in anyway, it no longer shows up on my camera, recent photos, or any other album in other apps to post. I thought it was a Facebook issue but as it turns out the photos no longer show up on fb, Lightroom, Vinted, eBay, etc. which is pretty inconvenient if you want to post something. none of the recent updates have fixed this issue. before it was a 5/5 now it's a 3/5 please fix this bug!

just leave it alone already. key moments, sticker suggestions, random photos bigger in the grid, notifications. like, dude, this is a photo gallery. not social media. store the photos, display the photos, and then leave me alone. look, go ahead, try stuff out, whatever. at least give me a toggle so i can turn this nonsense off. you harvest every byte of data from every human life and NONE of it shows that you guys are ruining things? seriously, just stop. it was fine as it was YEARS ago.

I have issues uploading pics to an app, if I edit the image at all (for example, I'll take a pic and my phone likes to rotate it the wrong way) I'll rotate the image upright, but if I do that, it wont upload to the app I use for work. My workaround has been to screenshot that image, then for whatever reason, it doesn't care that I edit THAT image. I can crop, mark-up, etc and it'll upload at that point. App is Service Titan (Field).

App freezes/crashes every time I go into collections. it's nearly completely unusable. I went online to find help and it's an issue other people are having but there's no workable solution and doesn't seem to be widespread enough to hope for a patch. I tried emailing the support email listed in the play store but it isn't monitored anymore because google doesn't care about users on its free services. I have tried everything I can think of but nothing helps.

Fix Google Photos, PLZZZZ! It used to be my favorite, GO TO for photos until a few weeks ago. I'm an artist, photographer, and major ADHD - I have come to rely on GP so much it's almost 2nd skin, and saved me so much time & hassle.Now, I can't even find all of my photos, albums, etc. Most 🤬 is not being able to just pull up a photo and attach or insert anywhere. Just spent over 1 hr trying to find a photo I had taken of an order that the seller asked for me to upload a pic. (Still can't)

Why can I download some stuff and other stuff, no. It'll just say downloading when I click on it but nothing. Sometimes I'll get a notification like 30 minutes later saying unsuccessful but it's completely random. I don't know why, there's no clues. it's annoying as hell. It can be the same batch of videos from the same day of the same thing, same album. Let's say out of 10, only 7 will download. The others are in some weird download purgatory. At least on mobile.

This app continues to get enshitified. In 2026 I thought I could send an album to Google photos without any issues but that's not supported. Instead, I selected each individual image and uploaded them thinking they'd be easy to find under recently uploaded. They were not. They were mixed in with my thousands of other pictures, which I'm obviously not going to look through. I'm just going to use another platform to make an album in the cloud. Crazy Google photos can no longer do that with ease.

In the more section of the app, I can no longer send, print, email, etc. I have tried everything. Every time i download photos from google messages, it doesn't go in the same day I downloaded it. It downloads whatever month or year they took the photo, which is annoying. It takes take me forever to find it. Every update it gets worse. Are you listening to what people are telling you. Stop sending us links to try to fix the problem you caused. That's what you get paid for.

Every update the app gets worse and worse. The options less and less. And AI slop more and more. I can no longer assign faces, the primary reason I enjoyed the app. Oh but I can steal art styles from hard working artists and make a lifeless recreation of an important moment. Gee. Thanks. -_- --- I wish I had the option to delete the photos in the archive suggestions rather than have to dig around and find them and delete them. I also wish there was a way to delete duplicate images.

This app DOES NOT duplicate photos, so if you plan on keeping your photos in the original app you were using, you won't. All of my albums are missing photos because they were taken and placed into google photos, once restored all the photos are mixed together. Also when the photo is "stacked" it only restores one photo. I have over 7,000 photos I was transferring and now everything is so disorganized and there's no easy way to fix it without spending hours trying to figure it out. I am so upset!

Just Terrible for the Users. No adjustments can be made for my convenience. It's the Apps way or No Way! can't delete from Google storage from the app, and just a crazy incomprehensible organization of photos and videos. This is what happens in Monopolies. They only care about franchising your data, not catering to your needs. ask yourself, when was the last time this app made finding my pics easier without paying a privacy price? Never is my answer.

My photos are disappearing. I've been using Google Photos for years and even bought extra storage, but for the past four months, I've regretted not just getting a flash drive instead. Many of my photos have vanished, including ones that were very important to me and my family. It's particularly upsetting regarding photos from when my children were younger. Given all the issues with these companies, including their hacks and overall practices, this situation is really frustrating.

I'm so flipping frustrated, every time I take a photo a little too similar to the last one or hold down the button, it stacks them. And every time I look for a button to unstack it, I can either never find it or it doesn't exist. it takes up so much storage; Please fix this, I press every button on that photo, and even the stack itself and I can't fix it. Also, I just don't want the usage of ai on a photo app, it's unnecessary and I wish I could disable it.

So annoying!! Yes I know I'm out of storage. The app completely inundates you with annoying popups, reminding you that you're out of storage, making it impossible to actually, you know, clean up space. I'm going to download all of my photos and videos off of your service, delete the app and never use it again because you annoyed me so much

The photos aren't lost, they are 6 yr old photos that are present in the Google Photos Cloud. I restored them to a phone so I may edit them and use them. Restored images are sitting on their original calendar dates instead of the top. How can you expect anyone using a photo editing app or other app to spend time scrolling through 2026 to 2020 images when they have a lot of images? It never used to be like this. Your links are not relevant to the issue. Something changed on the backend. Thanks

I am paying for Google photo storage for 3TB.... yet there is no customer support to help you when the features don't work. I finally got all my photos uploaded and the face recognition stopped working. it does not see that there is even a face....and when it does, it is not automatically tagging a person. I have face groups turned on, I have cleared the cache, and sent feedback multiple times with requests to email me to troubleshoot.... but I get no help.

Photos is forcing AI generated "creations" that use your photos. If you want to use the image search and ask questions about pictures, you have to have this enabled. There is no way to disable it. I have turned everything off except the AI itself so I can still image search, but it is analyzing my photos without me telling it to. And it's generating extremely ugly AI images and pinning them at the top of my gallery in giant tiles that can't be hidden... Yet another awful addition in a long line.

Changes in app aren't reflected in Google photos on desktop. I only used the app because I can't see stacks of photos in the browser version. I thought this would be a good way to find and remove duplicate photos, since Google still does not have a duplicate removal tool. (I assume that this is because they want us to waste space in our accounts, so we have to pay for it.) After using the app on my Chromebook, I was disgusted to find that none of the photos I'd removed had actually been deleted.

The app is absolute garbage. Apparently it saves your files to the cloud and when you remove them, the files are also removed from your device. and Google purposefully made it so that no contact could be made with them directly for this issue or really any issue. i keep getting notified about the storage from Goodle being low and that the options are to remove files or to pay for more storage. To basically continue to send or receive emails.

First of all, when people write a review, they are looking for a solution, not for an evasive reply ("yea, yeah, whatever. Next!) Your app has basically hijacked my pictures. Every time I open it, it will give me a screen telling me to continue using the arrange my photos by face group, or something like that. No opportunity is provided to "proceed" or "decline" this feature. Basically, I no longer have access to any graphic information that was created, copied, downloaded, or produced.

Why have thumbnails of different sizes for photos. I dictate which of my pics are important, NOT Google. Even then, I want an easily browsable system, not a social media wannabe with useless "Remix" and "Memories" features. Just be the damned file system you are supposed to be. Can't even swipe to select multiple anymore. Also, there is not an option to have your photos ONLY on device. No, I don't need to pay for more Google One storage when my phone has 300 free gigs left for photos and videos.

It's mostly good but some photos don't have my face highlighted or those of other ppl. There's no way to manually add a face so when I go to look up pictures of myself for sharing, etc. those photos aren't available and I have to scroll to find them if I don't know the date. Very inconvenient. Pleeeeeease add a manual face adding option.

I don't know how this hasn't been addressed yet, but there has to be a way to stop the little motion preview you get while swiping through motion photos!!! Even with autoplay motion toggle off, there is still a second long preview of the motion in the photo for some reason! It's frustratingly annoying! Especially when trying to swipe through and compare multiple similar photos to see which ones are best, its so jarring that you can't even see the differences fast enough because of the motion!

along with the Constant bugs I have with the phone in general, pixel 10 pro XL, now I can't even crop an image without the app shrinking the image to the point I can barely see it, then when I take my finger off the screen, it jumps back to the original size and the edit is completely wonky. I thought Google was supposed to SET the bar for Android phones, not cause people to switch OS entirely. 👍 edit: you can pass the feedback along to the teams. It's literally your job. 🫡

Google photos is the only option my phone came with. It's been fine until this last update. Before the last update, when you opened the app your photos would be shown by month/year taken so you only needed to scroll down to see older ones. It was easy and organized. With the new update, the organization is gone. All photos/videos are now shown in a haphazard mess. Sad. This app came with the phone and cannot be deleted and replaced.

New: "Deleting from device" even though it is backed up just deletes it from my photos. No longer showing any of my older photos that are stored in the cloud, but my "best of" highlights end up showing more than the photos that are showing up. View day on said highlights lead nowhere. I have paid for extra storage for years to be able to access these files whenever but am no longer able to do so. New update has not fixed any of these problems, nor has the advice given in the reply.

Search doesn't work like it used to, so it kind of makes this app worthless to me! With nearly 60k photos I can no longer search for SOME family and friends names in label descriptions I've make over many years, very frustrating. I've contaced google and they cannot find a resolution! Oh, and also something new, the app actually erases what I type on the description! I have to remember to copy text so I can cut and paste, or I have to retype everything!

What have you done to this app? I noticed that a couple of my album covers have been changed; not by me, and the simple instructions for changing album covers seem to have disappeared. The instructions for changing wallpaper remain; thankfully you haven't seen fit to change that unasked. Another case of it's not broken, so let's break it?

Been steadily getting worse for years, dressed up as being smarter. Any setting I choose or directive I issue I mean absolutely unconditionally, but the app invents "but I know better" options. To be clear, devs — on a roaming mobile network of bad quality with 3% battery at silicon-melting temps, if I say to backup a 1TB file now, I mean fully saturate my upload bandwidth immediately and until the phone is dead, even if it's dead forever by my choices.

God, I Wish there was another app I could use as my primary. This has got to be THE MOST USELESS photo managing app I've EVER seen. It needlessly splits photos up arbitrarily between seperate albums in a seemgly random order, asks me if I want to backup my photos and MANY other popups that a photo app doesn't need, EVEN AFTER SAYING NO EVERY TIME, like, I JUST want to look at my photos- nope. popup. I want to see ALL my photos? nope. randomly split between 5 seperate albums. why? who designed it

Google Photos is and always has been a very great tool for managing your photo gallery and syncing it between devices. However, I'm not super fond of the AI stuff everywhere. I wish there was an opt-out toggle. If I want AI to edit my photos, I'll go to the Gemini app for that, not Google Photos, because AI doesn't belong there.

I have a problem. in the app it only shows about 1/20 of the photos and videos I actually have. buy if I go to photos in a browser it shows all of them.. this has been happening for years. I don't know how to fix it. all emails and feedback are disregarded or are ignored completely. so ive started using terracotta. one terabytes of storage free.

It has great features but after years of allowing us free storage when uploading in storage saver mode, they changed their policy and I'm out of storage. It feels like they intentionally did this after first trying to hook us and this idea turns me away from wanting to give them my money for more storage (which I imagine would run out pretty quickly).

Meh. Adequate, at best. Easier to do things with your photos via website - and even then, it ain't great. Tools are not consistently available for all images. App is best for image storage and retrieval. Don't try to do anything fancy, or beyond basic. And ordering prints?! LOL. Your options for cropping, adjusting anything are WOEFULLY limited. Disappointing.

the widget doesn't let you pick albums or favorites. only people+pets and memories. but just because I took a picture of my fridge so I could use it at the grocery store, or notes so I could keep them for later, doesn't mean I need them in "my memories"? I take pictures of documents too. but with this widget it'd be on full display at some point. I can't use it. Google it can't be that hard to change that. it's useless with "my memories" showing random photos, including things I DONT WANT SHOWN

Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆ A Total Storage Trap! They makes it incredibly easy to upload your photos, but the moment you hit your storage limit, it becomes a total nightmare. ​They essentially force you to delete your pictures one by one, making it impossible to easily clean out your account or manage your files in bulk. It feels like a trap designed to frustrate you into paying for more space. ​Do yourself a favor: skip the cloud headache and just buy an external hard drive on Amazon.

Forcing a multisized photo layout is the most insane design choice I've seen from google in a long time. I want to be able to view my photos in order, which requires them to be the same size. This isn't a social media page, it's a personal photo gallery. I don't want to be forced to have it look "aesthetically pleasing" (which it is not...) when I really just need functionality.

Absolutely love this app! It's been many years now since I've had Google photos and love it more than ever. My favorite are the memories that pop up all the time taking me back to different years, different places, different events, different people, etc. I always look forward to seeing what pops up. I recently just learned I could buy more photo storage with a Google play card, so now I'm set.

You changed the photo editing format and buried all the useful tools deep inside and I can't tell you how annoying I find it . I used to be able to edit photos in seconds flat and now it takes me 5 times longer . For What ? Leave well enough alone . I have read multiple other peoples conversations on multiple platforms and you have frustrated millions of people, for what ? Why ? What have you achieved other than making it harder on users instead of easier .?? Please put it back how it was .TY

It's okay to store your photos, but there are a lot of issues. The Issues started for me when AI was added. What's ridiculous is.... it can't even follow the most simple instructions. Constantly it will State things like, "I don't have the capabilities to do that." Seriously!!!!!! You can't cut the dog out of a photo, to make her into a sticker?????? Then there's the "Once Loved" Editing Tools.. I used to be able to take a photo of a cat, and blur everything around the cat. Horrible!

Next time I'll get a phone under another name. I hate this app. Constantly trying to trick you into using their backup so they can charge you more. Search function sucks. They put Screenshots in random places, sometimes *even* in a Screenshots collection, sometimes not. Also, they will actually *REMOVE * photos from your device if you have backup turned on - found that out the hard way one day when I had no internet access, photos were gone from device. I'll look for another app. This is POS.

I used to really like this app but things have gotten so confusing that it's nearly impossible to find pictures. I don't understand why sometimes pictures from the cloud show up and sometimes they don't. Why can I not see all my pictures in the main feed? Often I'll save a picture and it will be seemingly nowhere. Screenshots are the worst. The only features I can appreciate are sorting people by face and the AI search to find specific things (when it works).

UGH. Now every time I edit a photo, I can't access it from any apps for some time. Google, are you looking at all of these reviews? Things used to work well. Now I frequently can't find photos and your links to "help" aren't helpful. Basic functionality should be prioritized over bells and whistles. The editing is awful, Magic Eraser doesn't work, AI editing is terrible, etc.

Google has lost hundreds of my pictures over the years. Usually by recommending certain actions. The first time it happened was when Google photos suggested I try a secure folder. After I tried the feature & I went to open the secure folder... the pictures were not in there, and they were not in the trash... they were permanently deleted. Another thing they do is recommend freeing up space, but they don't tell you that they take your photos from your phone gallery and put them in the cloud.

I've generally enjoyed the photo app over the years, but recently I've had issues with photos syncing across devices, or even on my own device after making edits. For example, 20 minutes ago I simply rotated a photo 90° in the phone app. The file has not updated on my desktop computer, and the image no longer shows up when I try and access it from any outside program like Instagram or Teams. In the photos app though it looks correct and is telling me that it has synced.

Good for photo storage and searching, but it sends too many memories/themed notifications each day and there isn't an option to fine-tune this other than to disable them. I like the occasional one to look back on but the current rate is pestering. Similarly, there's a pop-up (I think about AI editing of something? I dismiss it because I want to 👏 look 👏 at 👏 my 👏 photos when I open the app) that holds up using the app for what it's for. it's gotten pretty irritating to use.

update: it's been months and no fix has happened. Completely unacceptable for a paid service from a tech giant. Fix this or make storage free! Shared albums won't sync! Now when others I've shared albums with try to upload photos, I can't see them on my end, online or on the phone. This was the only workaround sharing photos across device types for years and now it's useless. What's the point?!

App is fine other than the fact it is impossible to disable automatic playback of motion photos. This means if you swipe through your photos, nearly every single one shakes for half a second and then changes color. It is extremely disorienting, and I can't imagine a single scenario in which this is useful instead of annoying. Motion photos themselves can be useful, but the way this app displays them is aggravating.

Worst gallery I have used and seen. You don't want your photos online? No problem, you can't make your own album or edit. You are forced to upload. I know there is an alternate Gallery, but you can't access it as the default gallery app from within the camera. I'll never buy another Pixel phone again. I really hate my phone and barely have it long enough.Another blow to choice and joy.

This is the worst photo app I've ever used. Instead of having a list of galleries, it creates "collections" which require extra clicks to get to where you need to be. On top of that, in some apps there's not always an option to speed scroll so I have to spend minutes slowly scrolling through thousands of pics. Why is such a basic feature not available in all instances? If I had a choice, I wouldn't use it at all, but I'm forced to use it to send photos and videos through messages and some apps.

Enshitification in progress. Recent updates have made it so you constantly see a banner at the top of the app if you don't allow Photos to send you notifications. Another similar banner keeps popping up if you haven't identified your face in the app. Neither of these things are needed for an app to store and organize my photos. Please stop making the app worse!

I have multiple folders in my gallery. The app doesn't give me the choice of what folder I want. When doing photo to video, I try to scroll down, but the app keeps switching between different folders randomly, and there's no way to stop it. Also, every picture I choose gets to about 45%, then stops. No explanation. Out of 30 or 40 pictures I tried, only 3 were turned into videos. Honestly, this sucks. I would uninstall this if it let me, but it won't.

The crop tool glitches if you use the auto crop and then try to adjust it. You can't crop from one side at a time, only from a corner. When you hold your finger to see the original, it shows you the pre-cropped version. You can't enhance and then see what was changed to adjust it. And you have to save a copy. These updates went the wrong direction. The only thing that's better is you can search for your albums as you're adding to them.

Just like all the other apps that started out great then they want to charge you. Can't get rid of duplicates easy. one time the app took a close up of every single face on every single photo I had ever stored and saved them as new photos. Including ones I was in process of editing, including memes, including screenshots of chats or whatever face happened to be in the picture the app blew it up. Nightmare.

I used to be able to search for memes and find them. Now when I search for the same things I have been, I am being told "nothing found". I don't always have time to put the pictures in their folders. Since switching phones all my photos got all mixed up and I can't find anything anymore! I liked the Samsung gallery better. I have even tried downloading photo sorting apps to help and paid apps but still the Google photos stays a mess. I have even tried to adjust settings to auto update folders!

🤬 Omg, STOP adding new features and STOP reorganizing the photo editing buttons! Previous versions were easier and now more difficult to find what I'm looking for. Also, where are the crop features that allow me to adjust individual corners and rotate by degree? bring those back please. STOP UPDATING it!!! If the app was good, don't fix what isn't broken. Seriously. Update: I needed the actual coordinates of my photos, not to open it in GMaps and go to a street address!!!

I like this app, but I can't change file names and I have been experiencing glitches with typed descriptions as a whole. Update 6/6/26- Some of my pictures haven't been showing up in my library, even though they are backed up and show up in my albums and other places in the app. This seems to happen when I have backup turned on, but when it's off, the pictures show up, like they normally should.

Up and down, finally a bit more stable. Some things are great, but base functionality of a photo gallery can be buggy. A lot of new features, but at its core, I just want a place for my photos be live, be accessible, searchable, and stable. The other features are nice, when the base is covered. At least I can get my photo information again - a couple years ago they really borked this app.

It wasn't a great experience to share. All my photos were gone! Nowhere to be found! Used Google Takeout only finding around 16 and continued to go on and on, using zip files I guess. Files not supported or file resized! Over 200 pictures were lost! Later I found out if a picture isn't backed up before archiving it's gone! How special!! Thanks Google for yet another error proof improvement!

More AI enshittification to an otherwise decent photo app. Slow. Unresponsive. Features I couldn't care less about. I literally care about two things: backup and adding photos to multiple albums.
